papers.title: Agentic World Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界动作模型能进行视觉预测和未来推演，但缺乏显式的组合式技能复用机制；而代码驱动的具身智能体虽能规划和复用技能，却常缺少对物理动力学的预测性 grounding。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AW-0 框架，将代码、未来视频和机器人动作作为三条耦合的生成流，在统一的 mixture-of-transformers 架构中联合建模；代码专家生成参数化技能程序与控制逻辑，视频和动作专家分别生成未来视觉状态和底层运动指令。还引入自动化数据整理流水线，为机器人和人类视频轨迹标注对齐程序，并将重复例程整合为可复用技能库。
ai_summary.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 和真实双臂操作任务上，AW-0 相比 VLA 与 WAM 基线取得更好的任务表现，并在语言遵循、语义推理和鲁棒性方面有提升。
ai_summary.novelty: 让代码同时承担世界模型中的多步预测/控制结构表示和智能体执行中的可复用技能程序，从而把规划、预测与执行连接起来。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型与具身智能体结合提供了新范式，说明代码化技能程序可增强机器人世界动作模型的可复用性、可解释性和泛化能力。

papers.title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

ai_summary.problem: 交互式世界模型需要逐帧实时推理，但其复用的视频自编码器来自离线文生视频模型，压缩率固定、不可重训，导致单帧成本高、动作生效延迟大。论文追问：世界模型应当如何、在哪一维、以多大程度进行压缩。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CADRE，一个开放的可控因果扩散表征自编码器族：在冻结特征上只加一个小瓶颈来调节时空压缩率，并共享一个自蒸馏到一步或少步的扩散解码器。在操作（manipulation）与导航（navigation）两个域各两个环境中，用同一世界模型在不同压缩配置的编码器上训练对比。
ai_summary.result: CADRE 覆盖了大部分延迟-质量前沿，移动相机场景尤为明显。四个发现：强压缩下扩散解码器比感知回归更锐利；机器人操作中时序压缩放在自编码器里比放在世界模型里更有效；操作与导航需要相反的压缩方向（相机静止时时序压缩代价小，相机移动时空间压缩代价小）；相机静止时粗空间 token 对运动质量的损害远大于对图像质量的损害。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地把视频自编码器的时空压缩设计作为交互式世界模型的核心变量加以解耦控制，并给出可复用的压缩选择准则。
ai_summary.relevance: 为实时交互式世界模型/仿真器的效率与保真度权衡提供了可操作的工程指导，并开源模型与代码。

papers.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
papers.abstract: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型通常只依赖当前视觉帧或很短历史窗口，难以推断质量分布、关节阻尼、表面摩擦等决定转移动力学的物理属性，导致在新测试场景中预测漂移严重。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PhysiCalWorld，通过上下文提示将测试场景中采集的探索性交互片段编码为紧凑的物理描述符 token，用该 token 将动作条件世界模型的预测锚定到实例特定物理行为；仅用潜在预测损失端到端训练，无需物理标签或解析物理建模，推理时描述符可复用且计算开销可忽略。
ai_summary.result: 在四个包含多样物理变化的仿真环境中，PhysiCalWorld 显著提升了 rollout 预测准确率和视觉规划成功率；学习到的描述符形成具有物理结构的潜在空间，并能泛化到训练时未见过的物理参数范围。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用可学习的上下文物理描述符 token 实现无需微调和物理标注的场景级物理校准。
ai_summary.relevance: 该方法让世界模型能快速适应不同物理环境，对具身智能中的预测、规划和仿真到现实迁移具有直接意义。

papers.title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
papers.abstract: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型需要一种视觉表征，同时支持物理状态理解、语言指令对齐和像素重建，但现有视觉编码器通常只擅长其中一两种能力。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 ALPS，一种预训练视觉状态编码器：用 ViT-B/16 从零开始，仅使用静态图像和文本，通过语言对齐、像素重建和空间对应目标进行预训练，再用跨视角自蒸馏进行精炼，将三类能力统一到同一组 patch tokens 中。
ai_summary.result: 在十五个公开编码器的统一评测中，ALPS 在 ViT-B 模型中取得最低的 LIBERO 状态探针误差，并可匹配参数量大 3.5 倍的 V-JEPA 2-L；冻结的 ALPS tokens 在 LIBERO 上达到 85.5% 平均策略成功率，在世界模型规划任务上匹配或超过领先编码器，且预测的未来 tokens 可直接解码为像素。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新在于将物理状态信息、原生语言对齐和像素重建统一到一个视觉状态编码器中，使单一表征同时服务于理解、预测和行动。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推动视觉预训练成为世界模型中理解、预测与动作共享的基础表征，对多模态世界模型和具身智能具有参考价值。

papers.title: ProactEgoMem: Benchmarking Proactive Memory in Streaming Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Today's multimodal assistants are typically prompted to interpret the visual evidence presented to them. To offload the cognitive burden of remembering across long horizons, wearable assistants should instead proactively acquire and maintain useful memory as the user's surroundings evolve. Doing so on the user's behalf requires identifying what matters, understanding the scene in real time, and initiating memory maintenance in the background while the user stays focused on their activities. We introduce ProactEgoMem, a benchmark that evaluates proactive memory in streaming egocentric video. Three tasks ground the evaluation in ambient environmental needs: Information Capture (IC) preserves transient yet dense visual information, State Tracking (ST) follows changing object states, and Location Tracking (LT) records object movements. The benchmark defines its protocol at two levels of proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely notification that satisfies the user's intent, while the deeper Intervention Level asks the agent to maintain memory on the user's behalf through an active start-to-stop tool lifecycle. Parallel ProactEgoMem-Daily and ProactEgoMem-Sci tracks contain 300/100 clips covering daily and scientific use cases, paired with 1000/500 questions in ProactEgoMem-QA, which measures the quality of the proactively acquired memory. Across proprietary, open-source, video-language, and streaming baselines, even the strongest models fail to capture memory both timely and accurately. ProactEgoMem provides a rigorous evaluation foundation for proactive multimodal assistance and for video agents that co-exist with their users.

ai_summary.problem: 现有多模态助手通常被动解释用户给出的视觉证据，缺少在长时间流式第一视角视频中主动获取并维护记忆的能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ProactEgoMem 基准，用信息捕获、状态跟踪和位置跟踪三类任务评估流式第一视角视频中的主动记忆；设置通知级和干预级两种主动性协议，并提供 Daily/Sci 两个赛道及配套 QA。
ai_summary.result: 在专有模型、开源模型、视频语言模型和流式基线中，即使最强模型也难以同时做到及时且准确地捕获记忆。
ai_summary.novelty: 将“主动记忆”形式化为流式第一视角视频中的基准任务，并引入从主动启动到停止的工具生命周期式干预评估。
ai_summary.relevance: 为主动式多模态助手和能与用户长期共存的视频智能体提供了严格的评测基础。

papers.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

ai_summary.problem: VLA 模型仅靠模仿学习难以掌握复杂长程机器人操作，而现有 VLA-RL 方法受轨迹级稀疏奖励影响，存在信用分配延迟、偏差以及子任务掌握不均衡导致的瓶颈问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AtomicRL 强化学习后训练框架，利用原子任务结构进行可靠信用分配和自适应探索。其中 SAPO 通过语义感知门控限制失败子任务的 TD 残差跨任务边界传播，BATE 根据各原子子任务掌握程度动态协调采样与局部探索激励，并构建 Real2Sim2Real 流程连接仿真在线 RL 与真实机器人部署。
ai_summary.result: 在 LIBERO-LONG 上，相比 PPO 在两个 VLA 架构上分别取得 3.6% 和 4.0% 的绝对性能提升；在 CALVIN ABC-D 上全任务性能最高提升 9.5%；结合 Real2Sim2Real 后，真实世界任务性能平均提升 21.3%。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将原子任务结构与语义感知门控信用分配、瓶颈自适应探索结合，形成面向长程机器人操作的 VLA-RL 后训练框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为提升 VLA 策略在长程操作任务中的强化学习后训练效率和真实世界迁移能力提供了可行路径。

papers.title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. Given these sparse targets, SP-MGM, a motion generation model trained through two-stage distillation, reconstructs coordinated full-body motion in real time. A pretrained motion encoder maps this motion to a compact latent representation. SP-GMT, a general motion tracker, then integrates the explicit sparse targets with this implicit motion prior for whole-body control. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot demonstrate improved motion tracking, whole-body coordination, and loco-manipulation success over existing approaches. Additional results and videos are available on our \href{https://sp-hlm.github.io/}{\textcolor{blue}{project page}}.

ai_summary.problem: 人形机器人移动-操作需要高层任务策略与全身控制之间的有效接口，但现有接口通常用单一动作表示同时承载任务意图和全身协调，可能加重高层策略负担或导致其中一方面表达不足。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 SP-HLM，采用稀疏姿态驱动接口，将五个任务关键身体姿态与学习到的潜在运动先验结合，分别表示空间意图和全身协调。SP-VLA 从多模态观测和语言指令中异步预测稀疏姿态与手指关节位置，SP-MGM 通过两阶段蒸馏实时重建协调的全身运动，SP-GMT 再将显式稀疏目标与隐式运动先验融合用于全身控制。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和真实人形机器人上的实验表明，该方法在运动跟踪、全身协调和移动-操作成功率上优于现有方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用任务关键稀疏姿态与学习到的潜在运动先验构成互补接口，衔接视觉-语言-动作模型与全身运动跟踪控制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 高层策略与人形机器人全身控制之间提供了一种可解释、可实时的接口设计思路，对具身智能和移动-操作研究有参考价值。

papers.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.abstract: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

ai_summary.problem: 现有具身智能体系统通常只关注指定目标，或把动作抽象成符号化执行，因此难以在持续变化的物理与社会环境中评估长时程任务能力。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出TARSphere全栈框架：TARSphere-Infra在带具身NPC和受限对话的物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，并用事件驱动有限状态机更新任务状态；TARSphere-Harness让冻结的多模态大模型通过多级可执行技能、分层记忆和执行反馈进行决策；进而构建含360个回合、30个室内场景的TARSphere-Bench。
ai_summary.result: 对8个多模态大模型的评测显示，通用模型可优于具身模型，但任务更新和人类交互仍很困难；频繁碰撞和摔倒表明，除任务成功率外还需评估执行安全性。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出面向 evolving physical and social environments 的机器人全栈框架与配套长时程具身基准，将任务语义、因果依赖、场景几何和安全性纳入统一评测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长时程具身智能体在动态物理与社会约束下的可执行技能、记忆决策和人机协作评估提供了系统化平台。

papers.title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态Agent的长期记忆难以同时做到保留细粒度视觉证据、可靠绑定实体身份并追踪其跨会话状态演化：抽象式记忆把图像压缩成文本丢失细节，像素保留式记忆又难以关联实体身份与状态变化。
ai_summary.method: 提出MHG-Mem多模态超图记忆，将实体提及与观测事实作为节点，用出现超边聚合同一身份的提及与事实，再合成方面级演化状态并通过演化超边、证据超边连接支撑实体、事实与源图像证据；同时设计基于超图的Agent搜索，自适应选择入口层、跨层遍历类型化超边并按需检视原始观测。
ai_summary.result: 在三个基准上取得一致提升，相对最强基线性能提高8.20%–9.98%，可同时支持细粒度视觉核验与跨会话状态变化推理。

ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态Agent的长期记忆提供兼顾保真度与结构化溯源的方案，对具身智能与长程对话Agent的记忆设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

ai_summary.problem: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成视频时，在teacher forcing下强时间冗余会让模型依赖局部视觉连续性作为捷径来完成当前块的去噪，从而缺乏对场景如何演化（视觉演化）的建模压力。
ai_summary.method: 提出Future Chunk Prediction（FCP）辅助目标，与teacher-forced去噪联合优化：在不访问中间视觉上下文的情况下预测时间上相隔的chunk。监督信号直接取自训练视频，无需额外预训练视觉编码器，且不改变自回归推理流程。
ai_summary.result: 相比标准teacher-forced自回归训练，在更低的总训练算力预算下取得更优的物理合理性；可视化表明FCP促使形成更结构化的表示空间。
ai_summary.novelty: 用未来chunk预测作为辅助监督，迫使模型建模视觉演化而非依赖局部连续性捷径，且零额外推理开销、无需额外编码器。
ai_summary.relevance: 为自回归视频生成与世界模型提供了高效、即插即用的训练信号，有助于提升场景演化建模与表示结构化程度。

papers.title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning
papers.abstract: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.

ai_summary.problem: 医学视觉-语言学习需要利用无配对文本的医学图像，并在保留已有表征的同时适配新影像模态。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出可扩展的模态专家库，采用 Multiway Transformer 结合共享视觉计算、确定性路由的前馈专家和独立文本通路；用模态感知视觉 tokenizer 在 7 种模态、1940 万无配对图像上进行掩码预训练，再用 323 万图文对做对比对齐。新增眼底和 OCT 专家时冻结原始图像与文本嵌入路径。
ai_summary.result: 在 ViT-Large 骨干下，方法在 9 种模态的 25 个基准设置中 24 个取得最佳或并列最佳；零样本分类平均平衡准确率 0.674，线性探测 0.856，双向检索平均召回率 20.70%。序贯新增眼底和 OCT 专家分别带来 14.95 和 9.31 个百分点检索提升，且未测得对先前任务的性能损失。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向医学多模态的可扩展模态专家库与冻结原路径的增量扩展机制，实现新模态学习与已有表征保留的模块化结合。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为医学多模态基础模型提供了一种可持续扩展、减少灾难性遗忘的模块化范式，对多模态大模型和领域增量学习具有参考价值。

papers.title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

ai_summary.problem: 多数VLA模型仅依赖当前观测的2D表示，几何感知方法又常需额外3D信息；而单帧推断出的几何往往被丢弃，未能积累为持久的任务表示。
ai_summary.method: 提出GeoMem-VLA，用冻结的几何基础模型通过几何流匹配目标监督可学习的GeoPlan token，使其内化当前场景点图与未来末端轨迹中的3D监督；这些token与观测表示的记忆结合，进行历史检索、自适应融合与事件帧巩固，推理时无需3D教师或显式重建。
ai_summary.result: 在LIBERO上达到98.9%平均成功率，RoboTwin干净/随机设置下为91.10%/91.24%，五个真实世界任务平均成功率为78.0%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将显式3D监督内化为紧凑可学习的几何token，并作为时间记忆服务动作生成，而非直接对齐VLM原生视觉嵌入或每步重建完整3D场景。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能VLA模型提供了一条高效利用3D几何与时间记忆的路线，对机器人操控和多模态世界理解有启发意义。

papers.title: Compositionality with Primitives: A Unified View from Euclidean to Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: https://github.com/nis-research/Compositionality-with-Primitives.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究组合零样本学习（CZSL）中如何从已见物体与属性中泛化到未见组合，并重新审视“必须显式重组属性-物体对”这一假设，同时分析嵌入流形几何（欧氏、球面、双曲）对组合推理的影响。
ai_summary.method: 沿用GDE框架，在嵌入分布Frechet均值处的切空间中分解出编码原始视觉概念的方向（primitives），并提出新的组合打分函数，直接使用这些分解出的原始表示进行推理，而不再显式做属性-物体向量相加重组。
ai_summary.result: 在CLIP、DINOv2、MERU、HyCoCLIP等模型上，组合结构一致地以原始表示形式涌现；直接使用primitives即可在MIT-States、VAW-CZSL、UT-Zappos50K、Clothing16K等CZSL基准上有效识别未见组合，并在Waterbirds、CelebA上提升组鲁棒性。
ai_summary.novelty: 挑战了CZSL必须显式重组属性-物体对的传统假设，揭示原始表示本身足以支撑组合泛化，并系统比较不同嵌入几何与数据集结构对组合推理的影响。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉-语言模型的组合性、流形几何与鲁棒泛化研究提供了统一视角，对世界模型中的结构化表示与概念重组具有启发意义。

papers.title: UniRAP: Towards Unified Part-level Physical Affordance Reasoning and Actionable Perception
papers.abstract: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言感知虽能对齐语义，但难以将高层语义落地为部件级的物理可供性与可执行几何，限制了语言指令驱动物理操作。论文旨在统一推理部件级物理可供性并将语言指令映射为可操作的几何表示。
ai_summary.method: 将问题建模为条件多模态生成任务，通过统一的接口 token 机制把视觉输入、文本指令与可选提示融合到共享时空表示空间。提出统一可供性解码器（UAD），借助中间分割特征联合完成目标检测、部件级可供性分割与 4-DoF 交互位姿估计，并配合由通用视觉解析逐步过渡到交互感知的课程式迁移训练策略以提升数据效率。
ai_summary.result: 在指代表达分割、可供性定位和交互位姿估计任务上取得 SOTA，并在动态视频场景中保持较强的时空一致性，验证了其作为语言引导物理操作统一感知框架的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 用统一接口 token 与共享解码器将部件级可供性分割与 4-DoF 可执行交互位姿估计耦合进同一多模态生成框架，并提出课程式迁移训练缓解文本标注稀缺。
ai_summary.relevance: 为语言驱动的具身操作提供了从语义理解到可执行几何的一体化感知范式，对具身智能与机器人操作有直接参考价值。

papers.title: OMAR: Open-World Multi-Attribute Reasoning for Scene-Conditioned Shelf Organization
papers.abstract: With the advent of foundation models, robots are increasingly capable of understanding and executing explicitly specified human tasks. Extending these capabilities to open-ended tasks, however, requires robots to infer appropriate actions from the observed scene. Household organization exemplifies this challenge, as robots must often act without detailed instructions, predefined object vocabularies, or known object-receptacle associations. While robots may follow instructions or learn organization preferences from demonstrations, inferring the latent organization of an occasionally changing scene and placing a novel object consistently with it remains challenging. We propose an open-world multi-attribute reasoning pipeline that grounds unknown objects across views and constructs an instance-level 3D scene graph for placement reasoning. First, a vision-language model proposes labels together with attributes such as content and packaging type, which are grounded through segmentation, depth, and multi-view association. Then, an LLM reasons over this representation to infer the latent shelf organization and rank scene-consistent object placements without explicitly user-provided preferences. The resulting placement rankings guide subsequent geometric and kinematic feasibility checks for execution. Our experimental evaluation shows that our approach leads to improved instance mapping and placement coherence over single-view language-grounding and geometry-only baselines, enabling autonomous placement of previously unseen objects without predefined object-receptacle mappings or class-specific retraining.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文解决机器人在开放世界中根据当前场景推断家庭/货架整理规则，并在没有明确指令、预定义物体词表或物体-容器映射的情况下，把新物体放置到与场景潜在组织方式一致的位置的问题。
ai_summary.method: 方法先用视觉语言模型提出物体标签及内容、包装类型等多属性，并通过分割、深度和多视角关联进行 grounding，构建实例级 3D 场景图；再用 LLM 在该表示上推理隐含的货架组织规律，排序与场景一致的候选放置位置；最后结合几何与运动学可行性检查执行放置。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明，相比单视角语言 grounding 和仅几何基线，该方法提升了实例映射与放置一致性，并能自主放置此前未见过的物体，无需预定义物体-容器映射或类别特定重训练。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用开放世界多属性视觉语言 grounding 构建实例级 3D 场景图，并让 LLM 推理场景潜在组织规律以指导新物体放置，摆脱预定义映射和重训练。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推进了开放世界具身智能中场景理解、常识推理与机器人操作决策的结合，对家庭整理和货架摆放等开放任务具有意义。

papers.title: APED-CXR: Adaptive Privileged Evidence Distillation for Chest X-Ray Grounding with Image-Only Inference
papers.abstract: Compact chest X-ray (CXR) models that localize findings suit deployment, but box annotations are limited and report-aware multimodal models are expensive at inference. We introduce APED-CXR, which distills report-informed spatial evidence from a frozen multimodal teacher into a student with 11.1M parameters that predicts diseases and boxes from shared evidence maps and requires the image alone at test time. During training, the teacher uses the radiograph, report, and queried class to evaluate regions proposed from the student's current evidence maps, and its support scores serve as training targets for the student's pooled evidence scores within these regions. Trained on PadChest and evaluated on held-out PadChest-GR, refreshing the student's proposals for teacher evaluation improves box-level localization F1 from 0.302 with fixed warm-up proposals to 0.338 (IoU >= 0.5; gain 0.036, 95% CI [0.022, 0.049]), while maintaining diagnostic AUC. This gain depends on the teacher checking current proposals: with equally many random boxes, a fixed dense box set, teacher-generated boxes, or report rules instead of the teacher, F1 stays near the fixed-proposal level, and proposals two refreshes old recover only part of the gain. On NIH ChestX-ray14, a secondary test set, box recall also rises from 0.423 to 0.447.

ai_summary.problem: 紧凑型胸片模型需要定位病灶以便部署，但框标注有限，而依赖报告的多模态模型推理成本高。
ai_summary.method: 提出 APED-CXR，将冻结多模态教师模型中由报告提供的空间证据蒸馏到一个仅 11.1M 参数的学生模型中；学生从共享证据图同时预测疾病和框，测试时仅需图像。训练中教师结合胸片、报告和查询类别评估学生当前证据图提出的区域，并将其支持分数作为学生区域池化证据分数的训练目标。
ai_summary.result: 在 PadChest 训练并在 PadChest-GR 评估，刷新学生提议供教师评估后，IoU>=0.5 的框级定位 F1 从 0.302 提升到 0.338，同时保持诊断 AUC；在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上框召回从 0.423 提升到 0.447。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是让冻结的多模态教师自适应评估学生当前提议区域，从而把报告引导的空间证据蒸馏为仅图像推理的紧凑定位模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为胸片等医学影像提供可部署的轻量诊断与定位方案，减少推理时对报告和框标注的依赖。

papers.title: Asking a Multimodal LLM Whether Someone Fell: Zero-Shot Screening of Low-Resolution Thermal Video in a Laboratory and an Occupied Home
papers.abstract: Thermal cameras can watch over older people living alone without capturing faces, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) can judge a short video without task-specific training. We evaluate a production multimodal LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash at temperature 0, as the decision stage of an event-triggered fall screener, used exactly as a deployed prototype uses it: one request per short thermal clip, with its sound track when there is one, and its predecessor Gemini 3.7 Flash on the same requests. On 438 staged falls and 563 non-fall windows that we located by hand in a public 32x24 thermal dataset, the deployed request called 69% of the held-out subjects' falls (67% over all subjects; bed falls excluded) and none of 499 non-fall windows, including people lying on the floor and getting up. Over 76 h of ordinary life in an occupied room, recorded at 160x120 with sound, it called none of 395 clips a fall (95% upper bound 1.2 false alarms per day) and caught 4 of the 9 staged falls the camera could see. One cautionary sentence in the prompt ("a person who goes out of view ... is not a fall") accounted for many of the misses: removing it raised sensitivity on the held-out subjects from 69% to 83% on 3.8 Flash and from 80% to 92% on Gemini 3.7 Flash, and in the home from 4 to 9 of the 9 visible falls, with no false call in ordinary living but at the price of calling deliberate lie-downs a fall. Sensitivity collapsed at 8x6 pixels (34%); identical requests disagreed on 4% of windows; and when the model called a fall, its explanation placed it within a second of the annotated landing 99% of the time. Two conventional detectors trained on the laboratory data caught nearly every held-out laboratory fall but raised 14.2 and 23.9 false alarms per day in the home. We release the frame-level fall annotations of the public dataset and every model answer on it.

ai_summary.problem: 如何在保护隐私的前提下，用低分辨率热成像视频对独居老人进行跌倒筛查，并评估多模态大模型在真实部署条件下的零样本判断能力与误报风险。
ai_summary.method: 将生产级多模态大模型 Gemini 3.8 Flash（温度设为0）作为事件触发式跌倒筛查器的决策阶段，按部署原型方式对每段短热成像视频（有音频则附带）发起单次请求，并与 Gemini 3.7 Flash 对比；在公开 32x24 热成像数据集和有人居住房间的 160x120 家庭录制数据上评估，同时分析提示词、分辨率、请求一致性和解释定位。
ai_summary.result: 在公开数据集留出受试者上检出 69% 跌倒且 499 个非跌倒窗口零误报；家庭 76 小时日常生活中的 395 段视频零误报，并检出 9 次 staged falls 中的 4 次。删除提示词中“出视野不是跌倒”的谨慎语句后，留出受试者灵敏度升至 83%/92%，家庭可见跌倒 9/9 全检出，但会把故意躺下误判为跌倒；8x6 像素时灵敏度跌至 34%，相同请求有 4% 不一致，跌倒解释 99% 落在标注落地时刻 1 秒内；传统检测器实验室灵敏但家庭误报高达 14.2/23.9 次每天。
ai_summary.novelty: 以实际部署方式系统评估多模态大模型作为零样本热成像跌倒筛查器，并结合实验室与有人居住家庭数据、提示词消融和失败模式分析。

papers.title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.

ai_summary.problem: 多序列脑部MRI的自动化放射报告生成仍受限于标注数据稀缺，尤其是低资源语言临床场景，现有资源多为英文报告、翻译文本或任务适配数据，难以代表真实越南语临床报告和多序列MRI协议。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了ViBMR数据集，包含3,649名患者、11,875个MRI序列，覆盖T1、T2、FLAIR和增强T1，并配对常规越南语临床报告；在此基础上建立了脑部MRI报告生成综合评测框架，覆盖代表性医学视觉语言模型、多序列输入和特征聚合策略。
ai_summary.result: 实验揭示了数据集特征和模型行为，并表明原生低资源临床数据集对于可靠的越南语脑部MRI报告生成是必要的。
ai_summary.novelty: 据作者所知，这是首个大规模、多序列、配对常规越南语临床报告的脑部MRI报告生成数据集及综合评测基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为低资源语言医学视觉语言模型、多模态临床报告生成和多序列医学影像理解提供了重要数据资源与评测基础。

papers.title: Robot Generalization Beyond Volume: The Diversity Path via Zero-Shot Capabilities
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots must handle tasks, objects and environments they were never trained on, yet zero-shot generalization remains one of the least solved problems in physical AI. In digital AI, zero-shot capability grew with the volume and, above all, the diversity of training data, much of it sourced from the crowd. Robotics instead relies on paid collection by a few well-funded teams, which yields volume without diversity. We formulate zero-shot generalization in physical AI as coverage of the deployment distribution, and show that more samples from the same collectors shrink the unseen region only slowly, while each new contributor can extend it. Building on this and on zero-shot learning, we propose a shared latent space for robot actions that combines multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning. As a scalable source of diverse data, we propose a community of developers building applications on one standard, approachable robot, Origami. We close with a testable hypothesis and an evaluation protocol relating real-robot zero-shot success to the diversity of contributed data.

ai_summary.problem: 物理AI（机器人）的零样本泛化仍是未解决难题：当前由少数资金充足的团队付费采集数据，只带来数据量的增长而缺乏多样性，导致机器人难以应对训练分布之外的任务、物体和环境。
ai_summary.method: 将零样本泛化形式化为对部署分布的覆盖问题，论证同一采集者增加样本只能缓慢缩小未见区域，而每新增一个贡献者都能扩展覆盖范围；据此提出机器人动作的共享潜空间，融合多模态对齐、生成式增广与噪声标签学习，并倡议围绕一款标准易用机器人 Origami 构建开发者社区来规模化获取多样数据。
ai_summary.result: 论文属于立场/框架型工作，未给出实机实验数据，而是提出可检验假设与评估协议，用于建立真实机器人零样本成功率与贡献数据多样性之间的关联。
ai_summary.novelty: 把机器人零样本泛化重新表述为'部署分布覆盖'问题，并以数据贡献者多样性（众包社区）而非数据体量作为扩展泛化能力的核心路径。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人数据规模化提供了从'堆量'转向'众包多样性'的新范式，若假设成立将影响具身智能数据采集与基础模型训练策略。

papers.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

key_lab_papers.title: Asking a Multimodal LLM Whether Someone Fell: Zero-Shot Screening of Low-Resolution Thermal Video in a Laboratory and an Occupied Home
key_lab_papers.abstract: Thermal cameras can watch over older people living alone without capturing faces, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) can judge a short video without task-specific training. We evaluate a production multimodal LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash at temperature 0, as the decision stage of an event-triggered fall screener, used exactly as a deployed prototype uses it: one request per short thermal clip, with its sound track when there is one, and its predecessor Gemini 3.7 Flash on the same requests. On 438 staged falls and 563 non-fall windows that we located by hand in a public 32x24 thermal dataset, the deployed request called 69% of the held-out subjects' falls (67% over all subjects; bed falls excluded) and none of 499 non-fall windows, including people lying on the floor and getting up. Over 76 h of ordinary life in an occupied room, recorded at 160x120 with sound, it called none of 395 clips a fall (95% upper bound 1.2 false alarms per day) and caught 4 of the 9 staged falls the camera could see. One cautionary sentence in the prompt ("a person who goes out of view ... is not a fall") accounted for many of the misses: removing it raised sensitivity on the held-out subjects from 69% to 83% on 3.8 Flash and from 80% to 92% on Gemini 3.7 Flash, and in the home from 4 to 9 of the 9 visible falls, with no false call in ordinary living but at the price of calling deliberate lie-downs a fall. Sensitivity collapsed at 8x6 pixels (34%); identical requests disagreed on 4% of windows; and when the model called a fall, its explanation placed it within a second of the annotated landing 99% of the time. Two conventional detectors trained on the laboratory data caught nearly every held-out laboratory fall but raised 14.2 and 23.9 false alarms per day in the home. We release the frame-level fall annotations of the public dataset and every model answer on it.

ai_summary.problem: 如何在保护隐私的前提下，用低分辨率热成像视频对独居老人进行跌倒筛查，并评估多模态大模型在真实部署条件下的零样本判断能力与误报风险。
ai_summary.method: 将生产级多模态大模型 Gemini 3.8 Flash（温度设为0）作为事件触发式跌倒筛查器的决策阶段，按部署原型方式对每段短热成像视频（有音频则附带）发起单次请求，并与 Gemini 3.7 Flash 对比；在公开 32x24 热成像数据集和有人居住房间的 160x120 家庭录制数据上评估，同时分析提示词、分辨率、请求一致性和解释定位。
ai_summary.result: 在公开数据集留出受试者上检出 69% 跌倒且 499 个非跌倒窗口零误报；家庭 76 小时日常生活中的 395 段视频零误报，并检出 9 次 staged falls 中的 4 次。删除提示词中“出视野不是跌倒”的谨慎语句后，留出受试者灵敏度升至 83%/92%，家庭可见跌倒 9/9 全检出，但会把故意躺下误判为跌倒；8x6 像素时灵敏度跌至 34%，相同请求有 4% 不一致，跌倒解释 99% 落在标注落地时刻 1 秒内；传统检测器实验室灵敏但家庭误报高达 14.2/23.9 次每天。
ai_summary.novelty: 以实际部署方式系统评估多模态大模型作为零样本热成像跌倒筛查器，并结合实验室与有人居住家庭数据、提示词消融和失败模式分析。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日研究明显集中于世界模型与多模态具身智能两条主线：世界模型侧关注视频自编码器时空压缩、上下文物理校准与视觉状态编码，试图把预测、规划与执行打通；多模态侧则围绕长时程机器人操作、时序记忆与3D场景理解展开。整体趋势是从“更大模型”转向“更可复用的表征与记忆结构”，强调无需微调的自适应校准和可溯源长期记忆。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日仅 Google 一家大厂上榜，方向为多模态大模型在低分辨率热成像视频中的零样本跌倒筛查，偏向真实部署与失败模式评估；其余论文多来自高校与独立团队，聚焦世界模型、VLA 与具身智能等基础设施方向。二者无直接重叠：Google 侧重应用侧的多模态大模型鲁棒性验证，学术界侧重世界模型表征与机器人操作框架，形成应用验证与基础能力建设的互补关系。
daily_insight.signals: 世界模型相关论文占比最高且集中在“表征与校准”而非单纯扩大生成规模，视频自编码器压缩设计、上下文物理校准、视觉状态编码三条技术路线同时出现，显示该领域正进入组件级解耦优化阶段。具身智能侧出现全栈框架与长时程基准、原子任务强化学习、稀疏姿态驱动人形控制等多种路径，评测基准建设明显加速。大厂参与度今日偏低，仅 Google 一篇应用向工作，学术界在方向定义上占据主导。
